newsitem.title: POLAND: ZLOTY FIXED WEAKER AT 2.47 PCT FROM PARITY RATE.
newsitem.headline: ZLOTY FIXED WEAKER AT 2.47 PCT FROM PARITY RATE.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland fixed the zloty at 3.1480 to the dollar, down from 3.1195 on Thursday and at 1.8230 to the mark, down from 1.8080, the central bank said.
The central bank fixed the zloty at an average of 2.47 percent from the weighted dollar and mark parity rates, weaker than Thursday's 3.25 percent fix.
The zloty was fixed at 2.43 percent from the floating parity rate, which changes in line with intraday currency swings on world markets, against Wednesday's 3.29 percent.
